fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the coming 1927–1928 winter tourist season in Greater Miami, concerns about price gouging (including electricity rates and rents), and the defeat of an auditorium bond issue. Coverage and columns discuss local politics and elections, transportation and road travel into Florida, and criticism of Florida Power & Light Company promotional leaflets and utility practices. Also includes items on law enforcement and courts (including a case involving Justice of the Peace O’Kell), community notes from Miami Beach/Coral Gables/Hialeah, and extensive local advertising and entertainment listings.
